methodology: Five fixed paired schedules; one faulty node per mutant arm; only assertions from the unchanged SafetyMonitor count as detections

experiments.scenario: A stale candidate seeks a vote after a client write commits on the old majority

experiments.defect: Grant a fresh candidate a second vote in the same term
experiments.scenario: Two simultaneous candidates request the same deciding follower's vote
experiments.assertion: assert state.voted_for == self.votes[key], "Persisted vote changed or cleared"

first_monitor_detection.assertion: assert state.voted_for == self.votes[key], "Persisted vote changed or cleared"

experiments.notes: Both arms use plain snapshot storage at the voter. Production MemoryStorage also rejects changing a same-term vote; this fixture isolates monitor sensitivity. The monitor stops before a second election.

experiments.defect: Acknowledge an external vote without its durable write
experiments.scenario: Grant a vote, crash and reconstruct the voter, then request a vote for the other candidate
experiments.assertion: assert node.voted_for == state.voted_for and tuple(node.log) == tuple(state.log)

first_monitor_detection.assertion: assert node.voted_for == state.voted_for and tuple(node.log) == tuple(state.log)

experiments.notes: The first monitor assertion is durable/volatile vote disagreement before the scheduled crash. A separately recorded, unmonitored behavioral continuation reconstructs the node and demonstrates the second vote; it is not counted as another monitor detection.

control.monitoring: behavioral continuation only; no observer; not a detection count

mutant.monitoring: behavioral continuation only; no observer; not a detection count

experiments.defect: Count an older-term replicated quorum without a current-term entry
experiments.scenario: Figure8-style older prefix reaches three replicas while its term4 no-op is withheld; a conflicting term3 branch wins term5
experiments.notes: Initial snapshots encode reachable uncommitted minority branches and their durable term3 votes. All election and replication replies come from actual core-generated RPCs; batching and automatic no-ops remain unchanged.

experiments.defect: Cap follower commitment by local log end instead of the RPC-verified prefix
experiments.scenario: An actual eight-entry retry batch matches a common prefix while an unverified divergent tail remains
experiments.notes: Both arms explicitly set a conservative next_index=1, match_index=0 retry fixture. The unchanged production sender emits the eight-entry RPC with leader_commit=11. The first assertion is conflicting commitment, before conflicting state-machine application.
